#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;

class DNekoIPrank {
public:
    int mod = 1000000007;

    int solve(int n) {
        int size = 2 * n + 1;
        vector<vector<vector<int>>> dp(size, vector<vector<int>>(size, vector<int>(2, 0)));
        dp[0][0][0] = 1;
        for (int depth = 1; depth <= 2 * n; ++depth) {
            for (int opened = (depth & 1); opened <= depth; opened += 2) {
                // From previous state with opened - 1
                if (opened - 1 >= 0 && opened - 1 < size) {
                    if (dp[depth - 1][opened - 1][1] != 0) {
                        dp[depth][opened][0] = (dp[depth][opened][0] + dp[depth - 1][opened - 1][1]) % mod;
                        dp[depth][opened][1] = (dp[depth][opened][1] + dp[depth - 1][opened - 1][0]) % mod;
                    }
                }
                // From previous state with opened + 1
                if (opened + 1 >= 0 && opened + 1 < size) {
                    if (dp[depth - 1][opened + 1][0] != 0) {
                        dp[depth][opened][0] = (dp[depth][opened][0] + dp[depth - 1][opened + 1][1]) % mod;
                        dp[depth][opened][1] = (dp[depth][opened][1] + dp[depth - 1][opened + 1][0]) % mod;
                    }
                }
                // Increment current state
                dp[depth][opened][0] = (dp[depth][opened][0] + 1) % mod;
            }
        }
        return dp[2 * n][0][1];
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    DNekoIPrank solver;
    int answer = solver.solve(n);
    cout << answer << "\n";
    return 0;
}
